title: Wealth
summary: When money, provision, or wanting more fills your mind — hold wealth as a steward under God, with open hands and quiet trust.
graceGuardrail: Wealth is not proof of blessing, and lack is not proof of God's absence. You are not loved more when you have more. Stewardship is fruit of grace, not a wage.
framing: Wealth includes money, skill, time, and opportunity. This reset helps you see provision as God's, release fear-driven grasping, and take one faithful stewardship step.
why: Scripture warns that love of money competes with love of God — and also teaches diligence, generosity, and contentment. Faithful wealth is worship with open hands.

steps.title: See wealth as God's
steps.explanation: The earth is the Lord's. Ability to produce wealth is gift, not self-made glory.
steps.action: Say: “Everything I have is Yours. I am a steward today.”

steps.title: Entrust the Provider
steps.explanation: Seek first the kingdom. Anxiety about tomorrow is not the same as wise planning.
steps.action: Name one money fear. Cast it: “I trust You with ___.”

steps.title: Exercise faithful management
steps.explanation: Diligent plans and faithfulness in little things matter. Stewardship is concrete: budget, work, honesty, debt wisdom.
steps.action: Choose one management step: review spending, plan giving, or ask wise counsel.

steps.title: Disperse with generosity and contentment
steps.explanation: Godliness with contentment is great gain. The wealthy are to be rich in good works — hopeful in God, not in riches.
steps.action: Practice one open-hand act: give, share, or thank God for three provisions you already have.

whenToUse: Money stress or money pride is steering your peace
You want to grow wealth without worshipping it
Giving feels scary, or spending feels uncontrolled
You need a gospel frame for provision, work, and generosity
sixtySecond: Say: “I am a steward, not the owner.”
Cast one money fear to God.
Take one stewardship step — review, give, or seek counsel.
prayer: Father, all I have is Yours. Free me from grasping and from shame. Teach me to trust You, manage faithfully, and walk in generosity and contentment. Amen.

scripture.insight: You cannot serve God and money — choose who leads.
Hope in God, not in riches; be rich in good works.
Trust in riches fails; the righteous flourish like a green leaf.
